lessons.title: Write the brief before the prompt
lessons.text:
A visual brief specifies layout, subject, contrast and rights constraints. Attractive output can still fail a brief. Keep reference provenance separate from generated images; do not infer ownership or commercial rights from tool access.

Turn an aesthetic wish into four inspectable constraints. Inspect the supplied input before using any tool. Write the decision rules in your own words and calculate one small result independently. The reference output is an answer key for this deliberately bounded fixture, not proof of general capability.

Policy for this project: Use your own or licensed references. Do not request a living artist imitation, protected logo or deceptive documentary evidence. Record provider/model and terms if generation actually runs.

For learners across regions underserved or excluded by mainstream providers: verify country eligibility, language, account/identity requirements, data terms, cost, quota and connectivity before choosing a cloud service. Use only legitimate available alternatives; never bypass restrictions or invent a country/account. No service access? Complete the labelled manual/fixture route without claiming a live AI run.

lessons.title: Direct a bounded revision
lessons.text:
A visual brief specifies layout, subject, contrast and rights constraints. Attractive output can still fail a brief. Keep reference provenance separate from generated images; do not infer ownership or commercial rights from tool access.

Change the title zone without accidentally changing the subject or aspect ratio. Build one inspectable transformation or bounded AI prompt. Keep calculation and validation deterministic where possible. If you make a permitted hosted call, save the actual response separately from the authored examples and verify its material claims; the supplied reference never simulates a live model.

Policy for this project: Use your own or licensed references. Do not request a living artist imitation, protected logo or deceptive documentary evidence. Record provider/model and terms if generation actually runs.

lessons.title: Test output against the brief
lessons.text:
A visual brief specifies layout, subject, contrast and rights constraints. Attractive output can still fail a brief. Keep reference provenance separate from generated images; do not infer ownership or commercial rights from tool access.

Check rendered pixels with a human, not metadata alone. Change one assumption at a time and predict the result first. Retain the failure, the revision and the rerun evidence. A failure is useful information: hiding a bad output or editing a test target after seeing the answer destroys the value of the experiment.

Policy for this project: Use your own or licensed references. Do not request a living artist imitation, protected logo or deceptive documentary evidence. Record provider/model and terms if generation actually runs.

lessons.title: Deliver an approved visual pack
lessons.text:
A visual brief specifies layout, subject, contrast and rights constraints. Attractive output can still fail a brief. Keep reference provenance separate from generated images; do not infer ownership or commercial rights from tool access.

Include the brief, candidate comparison and a clear approval/hold decision. Deliver a reproducible bundle rather than a screenshot alone. Include inputs, rules, output, failure tests, a short README and residual limitations. Ask another person to follow the instructions if possible; self-review and actual external review must be labelled separately.

Policy for this project: Use your own or licensed references. Do not request a living artist imitation, protected logo or deceptive documentary evidence. Record provider/model and terms if generation actually runs.

expected.json — fixture answer key
actual.json — result actually observed
evidence-log.csv — baseline plus three changes
README.md — reproduction and access route
limitations.md — unresolved failures, rights, approvals and scope
Never bundle a credential.
